title: Timeouts and 5xx on orders-api
description: Elevated latency on orders-api (p95 332ms) with rising errors reported by consumers.
root_cause_detail: An in-process cache in orders-api had no eviction policy or TTL and grew without bound.
expected_symptoms: orders-api memory_usage climbs gradually from ~39% to ~100% over ~38+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on orders-api
orders-api p95 latency rises from ~98ms to ~332ms as memory grows
orders-api errors appear late, error rate up to ~16.8%
orders-api db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
resolution: Restarted the pods to restore service and added a max size and TTL to the cache.
